Integration Process: Test integration when a new user registers and then signs in with the same credentials
Pre-condition: User is not registered yet and enters a valid name, email, password and date of birth
Expected Result: Verify the account is created, then the same email and password are used to sign in and a session is returned

Integration Process: Test integration when a user signs in, the session is kept in secure storage
Pre-condition: User is signed out and enters correct credentials
Expected Result: Verify the session is held in memory and can be loaded back from secure storage after an app restart

Integration Process: Test integration when a user signs in and out, the screens that watch the session are told
Pre-condition: A screen has subscribed to session changes
Expected Result: Verify the listener receives the session on sign-in and null on sign-out

Integration Process: Test integration when a suspended user tries to sign in, the suspension notice is built from the server's refusal
Pre-condition: User's account is suspended with a reason and level
Expected Result: Verify no session is saved and the suspension screen receives the reason and level

Integration Process: Test integration when an access token has expired during a request, the client refreshes it and retries
Pre-condition: User is signed in and the server rejects the old access token with 401
Expected Result: Verify the request is retried with the new token and the new token pair is saved to secure storage

Integration Process: Test integration when the refresh token is rejected, the user is signed out everywhere
Pre-condition: User is signed in and both the access token and the refresh token are no longer valid
Expected Result: Verify the 401 is handed back, memory is cleared and secure storage no longer holds a session

Integration Process: Test integration when a user logs out, the server is told to revoke the sign-in
Expected Result: Verify a revoke request is sent with the refresh token and the saved session is cleared

Integration Process: Test integration when the developer changes the API address, later requests use it
Expected Result: Verify requests go to the new host after the change and the setting is kept in secure storage

Integration Process: Test integration when a user types a search and the Marketplace opens with the suggested filters
Pre-condition: User types 'cheap secondhand iphone' in the search helper
Expected Result: Verify the filters handed to the Marketplace screen are read back as the same category and price limit

Integration Process: Test integration when two items are in neighbouring value brackets, the offer rules price the bridge
Pre-condition: User offers a 450-Leaf item for a 520-Leaf item
Expected Result: Verify the items fall in Brackets 3 and 4, the offer is a bridge-up and the proposer owes 30 Leaves

Integration Process: Test integration when a Premium user sees the bridging fee for the same offer
Pre-condition: User offers a Bracket 3 item for a Bracket 4 item and has Premium
Expected Result: Verify the standard fee is 30 Leaves and the Premium user is shown the reduced fee of 24

Integration Process: Test integration when a user plans a meetup, hubs are ordered by distance and the nearest can be booked
Pre-condition: User is in Cebu City and two hubs exist, one near and one far
Expected Result: Verify the nearer hub is listed first and choosing it with a future day and time leaves no missing item
